title: Simple Discord Whitelist
body:
# Simple Discord Whitelist
A lightweight and efficient solution to secure your Minecraft server using Discord.

### What is it?
Simple Discord Whitelist is a plugin designed to link your Minecraft server with your Discord community. It ensures that only members of your Discord (with a specific role) can connect to your game server.

---

## Quick Setup Guide

### 1. Create the Discord Bot
1. Go to the Discord Developer Portal.
2. Click "New Application" and give it a name of your choice.
3. Go to the "Bot" tab (left sidebar).
4. Critical Step: Scroll down to the "Privileged Gateway Intents" section and ENABLE ONLY:
   - SERVER MEMBERS INTENT
   (Other intents are no longer required, making the bot lighter and more private!)
5. Click "Reset Token" to copy your token. Keep it safe; it is the key to your bot.

### 2. Invite the Bot to Your Server
1. Go to "OAuth2" -> "URL Generator".
2. Under "Scopes", check: bot and applications.commands.
3. Under "Bot Permissions", check: Administrator (or Manage Roles and Send Messages if you prefer manual management).
4. Copy the generated link and paste it into your browser to invite the bot to your server.

### 3. Retrieve Identifiers (IDs)
1. Open your Discord Settings -> Advanced -> Enable "Developer Mode".
2. Right-click your Discord server icon and click "Copy Server ID" (this is your Guild ID).
3. Paste this ID and your Token into the plugin configuration file (config.yml).

---

## Why Choose Simple Discord Whitelist?
- Ultra Lightweight: Uses very few server resources.
- Maximum Security: Uses the latest Discord technologies (Slash Commands).
- Automatic: If a player loses their role on Discord, they are instantly removed from the Minecraft whitelist.
- Simple: No complex commands; everything is managed through clear menus.
